Bachelors degree in related area and/or equivalent experience and training
Master’s Degree in a technical or business discipline
Previous project management / lead experience
Experience working in an academic hospital IT department
Demonstrated experience of integrating applications across the Epic EHR ecosystem
7 plus years experience architecting, developing, deploying, and supporting complex computing applications in a medium to large scale environment, or equivalent experience

Incumbent creates high quality solution designs which address all architectural concerns including business, information, application, and infrastructure. Designs architecture which will align with business blueprints, delivery constraints, enterprise business services, enterprise framework services, and infrastructure standards. Delivers design solutions that promote flexibility, scalability, and high-performance.
Must be willing and able to work occasional weekends and evenings as needed
Understanding of mapping data from systems outside an EMR/Epic, such as third party vendors and/or large file uploads into IT-supported systems, including Epic
Knowledge of University and Medical Center organizations, policies, procedures and forms
Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Demonstrated organizational and project management skills
Demonstrated ability in determining how technology can be applied to meet business needs
Broad knowledge of business process including disaster recovery, business continuity and risk management
Ability to take creative and abstract concepts and produce a solid application framework
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System, School of Medicine, UCI Research Administration and other UC System campuses
Ability to discover and define technical requirements and their relationship to functional requirements and to determine the adequacy of documented requirements for architecture definition
Ability to design and manage high-level projects and development of end-to-end processes
